context: Monthly revenue time series with 30 months of actuals and a 6-month forecast fan chart showing 50/80/95% confidence bands, animated story-mode reveal with event annotations.
first_impression: Structurally honest line chart with statistically correct confidence intervals but a few brittle edges.
what_works: Y-domain is fully data-driven via d3.min/d3.max over all values including CI bounds; confidence band widths use correct normal quantile z-scores (0.674, 1.282, 1.960) rather than arbitrary multipliers.
what_doesnt: Y-axis padding uses hardcoded absolute offsets (−0.3, +0.4) that break proportionality under a scaling metamorphic transform; no line.defined() guard means any future missing values would draw false continuity silently.
